title: 第1章 三大女帝的变态要求第2章 与女帝双修激发混沌剑体
slug: 成为女帝炉鼎我踏上了无敌路
content_zh:
天云山脉，生命禁区葬渊。
“李易弟弟，三年了，你已经突破到万法境，现在该与我双修了。”
一位性感知温婉的女子，端着香气袅袅的圣龟神参汤莲步款款走来。
她乃上界的玉衡女帝。
一袭红裙，美艳动人，像是一名新娘，她长有一张完美无瑕的鹅蛋脸，体态丰腴，婀娜多姿，声音充满磁性，性感而成熟，让人看一眼便沉醉。
“可以，但双修后，你们必须放我回去。”
李易平静地望着面前的玉衡女帝，没有激动，也没有欣喜。
他知道自己是作为炉鼎的存在，这位无上女帝提出双修，并不是喜欢自己，而是采阳补阴，祛除阴毒诅咒。
三年前。
李易被宗门内的大师兄周元丰骗到天云山脉，伙同其家族的高手围杀他，并挖走了他的真龙圣骨，抽走龙筋，就被抛尸到生命禁区葬渊。
李易本以为自己死定了。
谁知道突然从天穹飞下来三名天仙般的绝色女子，将他的身躯接住，并带着他进入了葬渊，然后救活了他。
李易还以为遇到了三位女菩萨，当即感恩戴德，谁知道这才是噩梦的开始。
这三个女子自称是上界的天璇女帝，玉衡女帝，摇光女帝，法力强大无边，能如此及时来营救李易，主要原因是他在剥离真龙圣骨后，显露出冲天的纯阳之气，被三人拥有的小塔感应到，才会迅速找来。
随后的日子。
李易天天被逼着疯狂修炼，吃药，接着三天被吸一次元阳，如此轮回，三年来毫不间断。
他想摆脱这永无止境的索取，回去给娘亲和弟弟报平安，与未婚妻订婚。
“不行，你想回去，还得答应我们三个条件。”
随着清冷的话语落下，一名身穿白色道袍，犹如天仙般美丽的女子御空飞来，盯着前方的俊俏少年。
她乃上界的天璇女帝。

银色的长发悠悠垂落，随风荡漾，眸若星辰般明亮，脸蛋绝美，雪白的道袍遮不住山峦般起伏的曲线，浑身不带一点烟火气息，宛若一尊谪临人间的仙子，圣洁出尘，美到了极致。
“什么条件？”
李易皱眉，只要能回家，付出多大的代价都行。
“我先说吧。”
最后飞来的摇光女帝微笑道。
她的脸上带着诱人的妩媚，容颜绝美，白皙嫩滑的躯体仅仅穿着薄薄的轻纱，胸前波涛汹涌，小腹平坦，玉足纤细，玲珑曼妙的胴体若隐若现，格外诱惑。
李易内心忐忑，不知道这三位女帝会提出怎样的条件。
“我的条件是你每天都要以真气温养这只小塔，并找到它剩下的躯体，十年为限，找不到，那就继续给我提供元阳，直到我不需要为止。”
摇光女帝从须弥戒中拿出一只断裂的小塔。
它只有两层，拇指大小，很精致，不知道是什么材质制成的，看起来不像是灵器，法器，没有什么灵性。
“可以。”
李易点头，他现在只想回家，这个条件还不算苛刻，便直接答应了。
“我的条件是你十年内必须达到破空境，并且每个月给我献祭一件纯阳之物，否则我将继续吸取你的元阳。”
content_en:
The Tianyun Mountains are a forbidden area of ​​life.
"Brother Li Yi, it has been three years, and you have broken through to the realm of ten thousand dharma. Now it's time to practice double cultivation with me."
A woman with a gentle sense of sex walked over carrying the fragrant Holy Turtle and Divine Ginseng Soup Lotus.
She is Empress Yuheng of the upper world.
Dressed in a red dress, she is as beautiful as a bride. She has a flawless oval face, a plump and graceful body, and a voice full of magnetism, sexy and mature, which makes people intoxicated at a glance.
"Yes, but after dual cultivation, you must let me go back."
Li Yi looked at Empress Yuheng in front of him calmly, without excitement or joy.
He knew that he existed as a furnace. This supreme empress proposed dual cultivation not because she liked herself, but to pick up yang and replenish yin, and get rid of the evil curse.
three years ago.
Li Yi was deceived by Zhou Yuanfeng, the eldest brother in the sect, to the Tianyun Mountains. Together with the masters of his family, they surrounded and killed him. They dug up his holy dragon bones and extracted the dragon tendons, and then his body was thrown into the forbidden area of ​​​​life and buried in the abyss.
Li Yi thought he was dead.
Who knew that three beautiful women who were like gods suddenly flew down from the sky, caught his body, took him into the abyss, and then rescued him.
Li Yi thought he had met three female Bodhisattvas and was immediately grateful. Who knew that this was the beginning of his nightmare.
These three women claimed to be Empress Tianxuan, Empress Yuheng, and Empress Yaoguang from the upper world. They had powerful magic powers and were able to rescue Li Yi in such a timely manner. The main reason was that after he peeled off the sacred bones of the real dragon, he revealed the pure Yang energy soaring into the sky. The small tower owned by the three of them sensed it and they quickly found him.
The days that followed.
Li Yi was forced to practice crazily and take medicine every day, and then he was sucked in Yuanyang once every three days. This cycle continued without interruption for three years.
He wanted to get rid of this never-ending demand, go back to tell his mother and brother that they were safe, and get engaged to his fiancée.
"No, if you want to go back, you have to agree to three conditions."
As the cold words fell, a woman wearing a white Taoist robe, as beautiful as a fairy, flew up from the sky and stared at the handsome young man in front of her.
She is the Empress Tianxuan of the upper world.
Her long silver hair hangs down leisurely, rippling in the wind, her eyes are as bright as stars, and her face is absolutely beautiful. The snow-white robe cannot cover her undulating curves like mountains, and there is no smell of fireworks in her body. She is like a fairy who has come to the world, holy and beautiful to the extreme.
"What conditions?"
Li Yi frowned, as long as he could go home, he would pay any price.
"Let me tell you first."
The last flying Empress of Yaoguang smiled.
Her face is seductive and charming, her face is beautiful, her fair and tender body is only wearing a thin gauze, her chest is turbulent, her belly is flat, her feet are slender, and her exquisite and graceful body is looming, which is particularly tempting.
Li Yi felt anxious, not knowing what conditions the three empresses would put forward.
"My condition is that you nourish this little tower with true air every day and find its remaining body. If you can't find it within ten years, then you can continue to provide me with Yuanyang until I don't need it anymore."
The Fluttering Light Empress took out a broken small tower from the Sumeru Ring.
It has only two layers, is about the size of a thumb, and is very delicate. I don’t know what material it is made of. It doesn’t look like a spiritual or magic weapon. It has no spirituality.
"Okay."
Li Yi nodded. He just wanted to go home now. The conditions were not too harsh, so he agreed directly.
"My condition is that you must reach the Sky-Breaking Realm within ten years and sacrifice a pure Yang object to me every month, otherwise I will continue to absorb your Yuan Yang."
